post_title: BRRRR vs buy and hold: same equity, very different cash.
caption:
Fix up a fixer, or buy it move-in ready? 🔨

Both end with about $65K of equity. The difference is how much of YOUR cash it takes. Head to head:

• Cash left in the deal: $13,700 vs $72,800. BRRRR wins.
• Time to first rent: ~5 months vs ~1. Buy & hold wins.
• Cash flow: +$82 vs +$115 a month. Buy & hold wins.
• Cash-on-cash: 7.2% vs 1.9%. BRRRR wins.

Two all. BRRRR frees up your cash for the next deal. It just takes more work and more risk.

Example numbers: $160K purchase + $40K rehab, ARV $260K, refinance at 75% LTV at 7.25%; turnkey $260K at 25% down and 7%; rent $2,300.
